summary: Configuring SAML authentication in AAP: create an authentication method of type SAML, then set the SAML Service Provider Entity ID, the SP public certificate and private key (with BEGIN/END lines), the IdP Login URL and the IdP Public Cert (add the BEGIN/END lines yourself if the IdP omits them).
questions: How do I configure SAML in AAP 2.6?
What is the SAML Service Provider Entity ID in AAP?
Does the IdP certificate need BEGIN CERTIFICATE lines?
